ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite monitoring and predictive forecasting platform for industrial and urban emissions in the National Capital Region.
ideas.title: DelhiSmog-ATLAS
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages technical difficulty similar to GeoNex-ATLAS by combining geospatial data processing with predictive modeling, a high-value priority for local government and sustainability judges in New Delhi.

ideas.pitch: AML and credit risk detection platform utilizing graph intelligence and LightGBM tailored for micro-lending to agricultural cooperatives in Northern India.
ideas.title: AgriCredit-Risk
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies proven financial intelligence patterns from Bito to an underserved regional market, showcasing complex algorithmic engineering that catches judges' attention.

ideas.pitch: Localized AI nutrition and wellness platform providing personalized meal recommendations based on traditional Indian dietary parameters and modern nutritional science.
ideas.title: AyushNutrition-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds upon the success formula of E-Foodiee by targeting cultural familiarity and health personalization, appealing to consumer-focused judges.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered patient acquisition, verification, and trust engine optimized for multi-specialty dental and medical clinics across urban India.
ideas.title: ClinicTrust-Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the rapid execution strategy of Global-Smile, solving a concrete go-to-market problem for local medical businesses within a tight 35-hour timeframe.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent student support and campus sustainability platform combining LangGraph, RAG, and automated resource tracking for large Indian universities.
ideas.title: EcoCampus-Agents
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the multi-agent architecture of the greennovation platform to address operational inefficiencies in large local educational campuses.
